meta.title: Session Artifact Folders
meta.description: Files a session creates land in a folder named after that session, so every session keeps its own outputs and the workspace stays easy to browse.

session-artifact-folders.title: Session artifact folder convention
session-artifact-folders.description: Artifact folder = session title; new outputs use paths relative to the working directory.
session-artifact-folders.guardDeny: Artifact paths must be relative to the working directory, not hardcoded absolute paths.
